response.text: Buy Vendor B if you plan to keep the service beyond a single year—its first-year cost is $18,500 (14k + 3k + $1,500 onboarding) vs Vendor A’s $18,000, but thereafter B is $17,000/year so B becomes cheaper after ~1.5 years and saves you $500 over two years (and more over longer terms); choose Vendor A only if you absolutely need the service for one year.
